about.label: Who I Am
about.title: About me
about.text: Hey there, I'm Christian! After working as a digital and print media designer and as an integration coach and lecturer, I have been training as a software developer at the Developer Akademie since March 2026, focusing on web applications including backend development. I enjoy turning a design into a working application.
about.highlight1: Based in Borken and open to remote work.
about.highlight2: I enjoy learning new technologies and keep improving my skills.
about.highlight3: I approach problems step by step and learn from every challenge.

skills.label: Technologies
skills.title: Skill Set
skills.text: My focus is on the frontend with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular, plus Supabase as backend. I keep up with the rapid changes in web development and am open to learning new technologies.
skills.ctaText: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.

projects.label: Portfolio
projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.text: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.

elPolloLoco.description: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.

daBubble.description: Team chat with channels, direct messages, threads, reactions and real-time updates. Sign-in via email or Google, access rules enforced with Row Level Security in Supabase. Guests can read channels but cannot write.

testimonials.title: What my colleagues say about me

0.text: I benefited enormously from working with Christian. His technical skills and proactive approach were crucial to the success of our project.

1.text: Christian has proven to be a reliable group partner. His technical skills and proactive approach were crucial to the success of our project.

2.text: I had the good fortune of working with Christian in a group project at the Developer Akademie that involved a lot of effort. He always stayed calm, cool, and focused, and made sure our team was set up for success. He's super knowledgeable, easy to work with, and I'd happily work with him again given the chance.

contact.title: Let's work together
contact.subtitle: Got a problem to solve?
contact.text: Looking for a frontend developer, or do you have a project I can support? Write to me, I look forward to your message.
